annotation.title_clean: Réponses au questionnaire : impact de l'IA et des technologies numériques sur les droits des femmes et des filles (Haïti)
annotation.title_en: Responses to the questionnaire: impact of AI and digital technologies on the rights of women and girls (Haiti)
annotation.venue: Submission to UN call for input on AI and women's and girls' rights
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: A Haitian youth organisation's questionnaire submission on how AI and digital technologies affect women's and girls' rights. It covers algorithmic stereotyping, unequal access, deepfake harassment, technology-facilitated gender-based violence and women's tech-training initiatives. It calls for a law controlling AI, training, accessible equipment, bias audits and women's participation in decision-making.
key_provisions_or_claims: AI shapes gender norms and opportunities in Haiti even with low adoption.
Calls for a draft law to control AI use.
Recommends disaggregated data, algorithmic impact assessments and regular monitoring reports.
Deepfakes and amplified hate target women journalists and activists; reporting mechanisms and algorithmic transparency are needed.
Highlights Haitian initiatives (PITECH, Ayitic Goes Global, Delac/SheCodes, ITU-EIF) that train women in tech.
